mapper.select: select message_id as id, date_ as date, contenu, cip, discussion_id as discussionId from app.message where (discussion_id, cip, message_id) = (coalesce(#{discussionId}, discussion_id), coalesce(#{cip}, cip), coalesce(#{messageId}, message_id)) order by date_ ASC limit #{limite} offset #{decalage}
select message_id as id, date_ as date, contenu, cip, discussion_id as discussionId from app.message where message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.insert: insert into app.message(message_id, date_, contenu, cip, discussion_id) values (#{message.id}, #{message.date}, #{message.contenu}, #{message.cip}, #{message.discussionId}) on conflict (message_id) do update set contenu = excluded.contenu;
